name: synapse
description: See every coding agent on your machine as a live node, link them, and let them share context and message each other

scripts.demo: rm -rf /tmp/synapse-demo && SYNAPSE_DEMO=1 SYNAPSE_HOME=/tmp/synapse-demo PORT=${PORT:-4848} node server.mjs
scripts.app:install: node scripts/build-app.mjs --ad-hoc && rm -rf /Applications/Synapse.app && cp -R dist/mac-arm64/Synapse.app /Applications/ && open /Applications/Synapse.app
